strips.name: rotor
strips.brief: A three-lobed returning brass blade, three large negative-space holes and a bright small teal axle; rotate progressively45degreesperframe, body silhouette target48sourcepx(24worldunits). No generic gear disk.

strips.brief: Two narrow curved copper/teal velocity ribbons trailing to the left; interrupted flecks suggest returning motion, transparent center, no full circular ring; emitter anchor staysat64,64.

strips.name: contact
strips.brief: A short three-pronged cutting spark matching the rotor lobe geometry, first bright narrow core then unequal brass chips and empty last frame, not an explosion cloud.

Fine pixel clusters with hard clean silhouettes; tarnished warm brass upper-left rim light, cool blue-grey steel shadows and restrained teal energy. No text, grid lines, labels, baked UI border, scenery, cast-shadow floor, opaque fog or giant glow. Match current pixel character and understated warm-brass game UI. Each row is an animation strip in chronological left-to-right order, constant canvas and anchor; no camera change or random sprite zoom. Transparent padding must isolate all cells. Actual returned dimensions and alpha bounds must be measured before consumption.

sheets.role: single patrol body, fire and target reception

layout.size_basis: Currentvisual.drone_radius_px9: circularbodydiameter18wu; wing1.7*radius plusendcap3wu gives36.6wu fullwidth. Candidate max74sourcepx at2source/wu rounds to37wu, neverfills64wu canvas.

strips.name: body
strips.brief: ONE small patrol clockwork drone, bell-like compact copper body, two short side stabilizers, one teal lens and a tiny bottom clock pin. Gentle mechanical hinge cycle; no fat round universal gear. Three world instances form the three-drone squad. Keep the central body approximately36x36sourcepixels (18x18worldunits). INCLUDING BOTH WINGS AND THE BOTTOM PIN, the whole silhouette must fit74x48sourcepixels (37x24worldunits) centeredonthefixed64,64anchor ineach128cell. This explicitsmallworldscaleiscritical; neverfillthe128cellwithabigdrone.

strips.name: muzzle
strips.brief: A right-facing small three-petal copper aperture flash with thin teal center followed by a segmented tapered energy streak; concentrated near anchor, transparent majority, no electric storm.

strips.name: reception
strips.brief: A restrained four-point target reception star with one square copper chip and small teal core, brief expansion and empty final frame. Never show before accepted target HP result.

sheets.timing_owner: Existing companion world age and next_attack remain authority. item_drone_fire is submitted attack cue; only muzzle/beam there. Reception requires committed result.
runtime_hooks: committed HP receipt for reception: additional presentation-only hook needed

sheets.role: cast seal and three-part clock-wave/committed target stamp

strips.name: cast_seal
strips.brief: A compact square clockmaker seal with three hanging clock teeth opens from a narrow vertical notch to three separated teeth, then clears. Authoritative cast gesture, not a generic circle.

strips.name: wave_crest_detail
strips.brief: A slender right-facing crescent shock crest, brass outer cutting edge with three small bell-tooth accents and sparse teal inner chips. Large transparent center; source is a crest detail, not a filled280-radius damage fan. Display extent must follow original actual pulse geometry; do not scale a64px icon into an opaque huge disk.

strips.name: target_stamp
strips.brief: Three unequal little clock teeth converge into a compact angular target seal then break into two copper ticks, bright frame very brief and empty last frame. Dedicated judicial clock identity, no hammer or UI text.
